name: HarmonyBench
description: Despite advances in diffusion-based image editing, manipulating multi-object scenes remains challenging. Existing approaches often achieve semantic changes at the expense of structural consistency, failing to preserve exact object counts and spatial layouts without introducing unintended relocations or background modifications. To address this limitation, we introduce quantity-and-layout-consistent image editing (QL-Edit) to modify object semantics while maintaining the original instance cardinality and spatial layout.
